_note: Omni-MM ReAct: BOTH reasoners must be VL models because _build_multimodal_observation() attaches actual media files to every intermediate search result. A text-only LLM can't see them. Use the same model unless you want a cheaper VL for the loop and a better one for the final answer.

rewrite_reasoner._comment: Cheap text LLM for query rewriting. VL models don't handle keyword extraction well, so use a text model here.

react._note: Primary adaptive mode receives the original question and embeds agent tool queries unchanged. query_policy/query_manifest are used only by one_search_parity.

react_reasoner._comment: VL model for ReAct loop — must be multimodal because each SEARCH observation includes attached images/audio/video. Same model as answer_reasoner by default.
react_reasoner._api_format_note: Set to 'gemini' when using a Gemini model/proxy. max_tokens=4096 — SEARCH/ANSWER + reasoning fits in this; 1M tokens causes OpenRouter to silently cap and truncate. Short timeouts/retries: MiMo hangs otherwise (was 300s×5).

answer_reasoner._comment: VL model for final answer — same as react_reasoner. Separate key lets you use a stronger/weaker VL for the final call if desired.
answer_reasoner._api_format_note: Set to 'gemini' when using a Gemini model/proxy. Sends video as image_url instead of video_url. Short timeouts/retries: MiMo hangs otherwise (was 300s×5).
